{{Top|leg}}
'''The Matrix''' was the industrial sound system used at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. Controlled by an operator and four [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]], the system had over 1,000 speakers placed throughout the establishment to provide the best audio experience for the club's patrons. The Matrix could play [[sound slug]]s, [[audio disc]]s, and interface with the equipment of live [[Music/Legends|music]] bands.<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
